hook: The Department of Labor nearly erased 9 critical wage rules from the federal code.

sections.voiceover: The Department of Labor nearly erased 9 critical wage rules from the federal code.
b_roll: U.S. Department of Labor seal on a federal building wall

sections.voiceover: Federal regulators published notice 90 FR 28985 in July 2025 targeting Title 29. Where did those 9 targeted interpretive parts originate?
b_roll: Open pages of the Federal Register
Code of Federal Regulations volumes on a shelf

sections.voiceover: Max Kutner reported the agency abruptly changed course on Tuesday.
b_roll: Law360 news report on a computer screen

sections.voiceover: Wage and Hour Division officials officially withdrew the entire proposal on October 7, 2026. This administrative action preserved longstanding Fair Labor Standards Act guidance inside the Code of Federal Regulations. Workers retained 9 protected interpretive rules.
b_roll: Wage and Hour Division office entrance

sections.voiceover: Check your employment rights under the preserved federal regulations today.
